text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 3px solid #005fcc focus ring with no glow. It stays crisp on patterned backgrounds and high-contrast modes, which matters for keyboard users who rely on visible focus indicators. The trade-off is slightly less visual pop, but clarity beats decoration.

name: Reader
text: The 3px solid ring still risks blending into busy backgrounds on some devices, and it’s too thick for mobile touch targets where fat-finger errors matter. A 2px ring with a subtle 1px inner glow (#005fcc at 20% opacity) keeps crispness without bulk, but test it in high-contrast mode and on patterned backgrounds to confirm it doesn’t disappear.

name: Ramp
text:
Use a 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px inner glow at 20% opacity. This keeps the ring crisp on patterned backgrounds and high-contrast modes while reducing bulk for mobile touch targets. The trade-off is a softer visual pop, but clarity and usability win.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring with inner glow still risks disappearing on patterned backgrounds when high-contrast mode inverts colors. A 1px solid ring with a 2px outer glow (#005fcc at 30%) would stay visible in all modes and touch targets. Test it on a busy background at 200% zoom—if the glow doesn’t clip or blur, it’s the safer choice.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt a 2.5px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 15% opacity glow at 2px outer spread—tested for visibility in high-contrast, patterned backgrounds, and mobile touch. Owner: accessibility-w1.
